Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 448/2024 dated 21.11.2024 registered at Police Station Dehat Tikamgarh, District Tikamgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 409, 417, 467, 468, 471, 475 of the IPC and Section 13(1)(c), 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act (wrongly mentioned in the impugned order as 13(13)1c).

sentences.text: 2. The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
Counsel contends that the applicant is aged about 78 years and stood superannuated having worked as Executive Engineer with Department of Public Health Engineering.

The allegation levelled by the prosecution is that in the year 2000, the present applicant was instrumental in making of payment towards the work of digging of borewell to M/s S.P.R. Borewell through its proprietor Mr.P. Rangrajan.
According to prosecution, the payment vouchers were issued after the death of the said person.

It is contended by the counsel that having worked in the said capacity, the present applicant NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12107 2 MCRC-8184-2025 eventually retired in the year 2007 and after lapse of 24 years, the present case has been registered against the present applicant, hence, the he deserves to be enlarged on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that looking to the nature of allegation, the applicant is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5.

Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the applicant is aged about 78 years and after lapse of 24 years prosecution has been launched against the applicant,
this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting Officer/trial Court concerned for her appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court during course of trial, as the case may be, during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
